links.outcome: Hallucination rate of LLM responses to patient questions on chest wall deformities
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o had the lowest hallucination rate (5.0%); DeepSeek-V3 had the highest (11.25%); treatment-related questions showed the most errors.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o achieved the highest overall accuracy (median score: 1.20), the greatest proportion of fully accurate responses, and the lowest hallucination rate (5.0%).

links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM outputs across repeated submissions on two days
links.effect: Reproducibility was highest for ChatGPT-4o (weighted kappa almost perfect), followed by Gemini and DeepSeek-V3.
links.quote: Reproducibility was highest for ChatGPT-4o (weighted κ = almost perfect), followed by Gemini and DeepSeek-V3.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the accuracy, reliability, and reproducibility of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4o, Gemini 2.0 Pro, DeepSeek-V3) answering patient-facing questions about chest wall deformities, but it evaluates standard baseline model performance without testing any specific deployment safeguard or practice.
